overview.description: The Baillie Gifford International Concentrated Growth ETF (BGCG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed international equity ETF that seeks capital appreciation through a concentrated portfolio of non-US growth companies with the potential to benefit from long-term structural change and market share expansion. BGCG was launched on Dec 14, 2017 and is issued by Baillie Gifford Funds.
